importErrors.sessionStaleRelogin: The sessionKey is invalid. Sign in to claude.ai again and import a new sessionKey.
importErrors.cloudflareChallenge: Cloudflare blocked this slot's SOCKS5 route. Switch proxies and retry.
importErrors.importFailed: Import failed. Check that the pasted credentials are complete and correct.
importErrors.proxyRequired: This slot has no healthy SOCKS5 proxy. Assign one before continuing.
importErrors.sessionExpired: The authorization session expired. Generate a new authorization link.
importErrors.sessionVmMismatch: The authorization session does not match this slot. Generate a new authorization link.
importErrors.setupTokenTimeout: The slot CLI timed out waiting for the code. Reopen the current link for a new code, including the part after #. Do not regenerate the link.
importErrors.setupTokenInvalidCode: The code is incomplete or already used. Reopen the current link and copy the full code, including the part after #.
importErrors.cliNodeMissing: This slot has no cli-node. Sync wrap-cli on the kernel page first.
importErrors.setupTokenUrlTimeout: The slot CLI did not provide an authorization link within 45 seconds. Check the container and SOCKS5 connection, then retry.
importErrors.bridgeFailed: The slot's SOCKS5-to-HTTP bridge failed to start. Check its proxy and retry.
importErrors.workerCredentialImportFailed: Credentials were obtained, but the slot credential service refused to save them. Check the slot kernel and container, then retry.
importErrors.placementForbidden: Only administrators can select a target node.
importErrors.nodeNotFound: The target node may have been removed. Refresh and select another node.
importErrors.placementPreflightFailed: The target node failed preflight checks. Fix the items below and retry.
importErrors.remoteUnsupported: This operation is unavailable on remote nodes. Official CC setup, wrap repair, and inference engine switching require a local node.
importErrors.kvmUnavailable: This host or node cannot create KVM virtual machines.

cache.explainOff: Leave messages untouched. Caller breakpoints remain active; the gateway only manages system and tools.
cache.explainRewrite: Remove all caller breakpoints from messages, then mark the last message; when messages≥4, also mark the second-to-last user message.
cache.explainCliHop: Strip cache_control from messages. The kernel reapplies conversation breakpoints following Claude Code.
cache.explainFill: Fill breakpoints only when messages has none. Preserve clients' existing breakpoints.
